name: Mansion-Hall-View-From-Entrance
logline_subject_info: The view into the mansion's opulent main hall from the main entrance, looking towards the grand staircase.
visual_desc: ROOM SIZE: Large, opulent hall, ~15x10 m, with a high 8m ceiling. SOUTH WALL (entrance): The interior side of the massive, dark wood double doors, currently closed. The wall is covered in rich, dark wood paneling. NORTH WALL (opposite): Dominated by a majestic, wide wooden staircase that ascends to a second-floor landing. The staircase has an ornate, carved balustrade. EAST WALL (right when entering): Continuous dark wood paneling, possibly with a large oil painting in a gilded frame. WEST WALL (left when entering): Matching dark wood paneling, perhaps with a tall, grandfather clock or a marble bust on a pedestal. CENTER: The floor is made of polished black and white marble tiles in a checkerboard pattern, completely empty and spacious. CEILING/FLOOR: The ceiling features a massive, intricate stained-glass skylight casting diffused, colorful light downwards. The floor is polished marble. The scene is empty of people. The hall has a stained-glass ceiling. The floor is smooth, made of marble or parquet, and is not covered by a carpet in the central area.
video_visual_desc: View from the entrance of a grand, empty mansion hall with wood-paneled walls, a marble floor, and a majestic staircase at the far end, lit by a stained-glass ceiling.

anchor_points.axes: X=[0,1] image-left-to-right wall. Y=[0,1] entrance-to-far-wall. Z=[0,1] floor-to-ceiling. View-To-Entrance: x_mirrored = 1 - x (left↔right swap), Y depth reversed.

zones.label: Entrance Area
zones.visual_disposition_hint: View from just inside the entrance. The checkerboard floor is in the immediate foreground. The bust and clock are on the image-left side, and the painting is on the image-right wall. The grand staircase at the far end of the hall is the main background element. DEPTH: entrance → empty floor mid-ground → far wall/staircase background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: View from the far wall. The entrance doors are centered in the distant background. The bust and clock are visible in the mid-ground on the frame-right side (x≈0.1 -> x_mirrored≈0.9), with the painting on the frame-left (x≈0.9 -> x_mirrored≈0.1). The staircase structure is in the immediate foreground. DEPTH: far wall/staircase foreground → empty floor mid-ground → entrance area background.

zones.label: Center of the Hall
zones.visual_disposition_hint: A wide, symmetrical view of the hall. The checkerboard floor fills the lower half of the frame. The staircase is centered in the background. The bust and clock are on the image-left, the painting on the image-right. The stained-glass skylight is visible above. DEPTH: entrance → empty floor mid-ground → far wall/staircase background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: A wide, symmetrical view toward the entrance. The far wall and base of the staircase are in the foreground. The entrance doors are centered in the background. The bust and clock are on the frame-right (x≈0.1 -> x_mirrored≈0.9), the painting on the frame-left (x≈0.9 -> x_mirrored≈0.1). DEPTH: far wall/staircase foreground → empty floor mid-ground → entrance wall background.

zones.label: Base of the Staircase
zones.visual_disposition_hint: A view focused on the far wall. The grand staircase and the double doors beneath it are centered and fill the frame. The checkerboard floor is in the foreground. The landing is visible above the doors. DEPTH: entrance → empty floor foreground → staircase/far wall background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: View from the far wall, looking back toward the entrance. The vast checkerboard floor stretches out into the mid-ground, with the entrance doors centered in the distant background. The bust and clock are visible in the distance on the frame-right (x≈0.1 -> x_mirrored≈0.9), the painting on the frame-left (x≈0.9 -> x_mirrored≈0.1). DEPTH: far wall foreground → empty floor mid-ground → entrance wall background.
